decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved trees.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).

description: Works to trees covered by LBE ORDER NO 13 1969: (T1) sycamore - crown reduction up to 1.5m from each branch end not exceeding previous points, (T2) lime - crown reduction up to 1m from each branch end not exceeding previous points,  remove basal growth and epicormic growth on main trunk up to 3m height from ground level, (T3) yew - remove epicormic growth on main trunk and crown break, reduce northeast branch tips of the crown to create up to 2m clearance between the building and the remaining foliage, reduce southern branch tips of the crown to create up to 1.5m clearance between the neighbouring cypress tree and the remaining foliage,  (T4) holm oak - reduce selected northern branch over false acacia by up to 2m, reduce eastern branch tips over shed by up to 2m, (T5) copper beech -  reduce eastern and western branch tips by up to 1m  (T6) cedar - reduce lower lateral branches on south, west and north aspects by up to 1m and by up to 1.5m on eastern aspect.
